## 使用方式

```bash
cd /opt/ZONGYUAN-ROOT/ai-native-ops
python3 cli.py deploy "腾讯云2核4G nginx https"
python3 cli.py verify --host 127.0.0.1 --domain huodouai.com --ssl
python3 cli.py truth list
python3 cli.py heal --error "502 Bad Gateway"
```
